user_story: As a user, I want to interact with the buttons on the Buttons page so that I can verify their functionality through single clicks, double clicks, and right clicks. Acceptance criteria: When I click the button with id 'sp5Bi', it should perform its action. When I double-click the button with id 'doubleClickBtn', it should perform its action. When I right-click the button with id 'rightClickBtn', it should perform its action.
